account_delete_message: Every message and file this bot received is deleted for good.
account_key_taken: Another bot already uses this webhook path
account_secret_hint: Used to check the platform's webhook signatures; stored only in your D1 database.
accounts_description: Stash receives messages through bots on each chat platform. Add a bot, then give its platform the webhook URL shown here.
ai_base_url_custom_hint: Up to the version, usually ending in /v1, without /chat/completions. If unsure, enter just the domain and click "Detect & fetch models" to work out whether /v1 is needed.
ai_base_url_official_hint: Uses the provider's official address. To use another address, choose "Custom".
ai_cross_language_hint: AI search works across languages: Chinese queries find English messages and the other way round (depending on the embedding model).
ai_description: The chat model analyzes messages and images (category, tags, summary, text in images, key facts) and must accept images; the embedding model powers AI search (finding messages by meaning). They can come from different providers.
ai_embedding_change_hint: After changing the embedding model, existing vectors no longer match; rebuild them under "Rebuild vector index" below.
ai_embedding_empty: Leave empty to disable vector features
ai_key_not_carried: The provider or address changed, so the saved key isn't reused. Please enter it again.
ai_key_saved: Saved {masked}; leave empty to keep it
ai_language_description: The language AI writes categories, tags and summaries in, including new categories.
ai_model_hint: Pick from the fetched list or type a model name.
ai_model_none: No matching model; you can type one
ai_need_key: Enter the API key first, then fetch models
ai_request_preview: With these settings, requests go to:
analysis_auto_hint: Queued once their files are saved; when off, analyze by hand.
analysis_categories_hint: AI picks from these first and adds a new one only when none fits. Press Enter to add.
analysis_daily_limit_hint: Per UTC day; the rest waits for the next day. 0 = no limit. Keeps costs in check.
analysis_description: Each message (text plus saved images) goes to the chat model once for a category, tags, a summary, the text in its images and key facts.
analysis_max_images_hint: Images over 4 MB aren't sent. 0 = text only.
analysis_not_configured: Set up a chat or embedding model above first.
analysis_reanalyze_message: This replaces current categories, tags and summaries (including ones you edited), runs within the daily limit, and costs model usage.
analysis_status_description: Analysis and vectors run in the background queue and are retried on failure.
app_tagline: Photos and messages from your chats, kept in one place
avatar_too_large: The image must be 2 MB or smaller
credentials_missing: Fill in the ID and secret first
data_events_description: A record of every webhook call, hits and misses, with the raw body. Messages themselves aren't affected.
data_tasks_description: Only failed download records are cleaned up. Saved files belong to their message and stay (or go) with it.
data_trash_description: How long deleted messages stay in the trash. After that, the messages and their files in R2 are deleted for good.
emails_description: Only Google / GitHub accounts with these emails can sign in. Locked ones come from the ALLOWED_EMAILS secret and can't be removed here.
emails_owner: From the deployment secret, can't be removed
emails_remove_message: This email loses access immediately, including existing sessions.
empty_trash_message: Every message in the trash and its saved files will be deleted for good.
error_generic: Something went wrong, please try again
events_description: Every webhook call is recorded: hits (saved as a message) and misses (ignored, URL checks, rejected or failed). Set how long they're kept in Settings → Data.
events_empty_hint: Once a platform has the webhook URL, every call it makes shows up here.
events_misses_hint: Ignored, URL checks, rejected or failed events
events_problems_hint: Rejected or failed: bad signature, unknown or disabled bot, storage error
export_cancelled: Stopped; the partial file was discarded.
export_card_description: Download every file from a platform as a ZIP, optionally with messages.json, for a backup or a move. To export part of it, use Download ZIP on the Messages page with filters.
export_failures: {count} files failed after retries (listed in report.txt):
export_include_messages_hint: Every matching message: text, sender, time, and where each file is in the archive.
export_mode_stream: Files are zipped in your browser and written straight to the file you pick, whatever the size.
export_mode_volumes: Files are zipped in your browser. This browser can't write to disk directly, so archives over 500 MB are split into parts. Chrome or Edge make a single file.
export_unsaved_note: {count} files aren't saved in Stash yet; they're listed in report.txt.
list_empty_filtered_hint: Try loosening or clearing the filters.
login_description: Sign in to see what you've received
login_error_generic: Sign-in failed, please try again later
login_error_no_email: Couldn't get an email from the provider. Make sure the account has a verified email.
login_error_not_allowed: This account doesn't have access. Sign in with an account whose email is on the allowlist.
login_no_providers: No sign-in method is configured. Set the Google or GitHub OAuth secrets on the server.
mcp_description: Let AI assistants such as Claude search the messages you received, look at saved images, and check or retry failed downloads. They sign in with the API token above.
mcp_tools: Tools: search messages, get a message, view an image, list bots, download status, retry failed downloads.
media_description: Failed downloads are retried automatically 9 times, backing off from 30 seconds to 2 hours; retry the rest here.
message_delete_message: It goes to the trash with its files and can be restored any time.
messages_empty_hint: Send your bot a photo or a message; it shows up here shortly.
platform_qq_step_create: Create a bot at q.qq.com and copy its AppID and AppSecret here.
platform_qq_step_events: Subscribe to message events such as C2C_MESSAGE_CREATE, then add the bot and message it.
platform_qq_step_webhook: Under Development → Callback, paste the webhook URL; the platform verifies it.
purge_message: The message and its saved files will be deleted for good.
reembed_description: Generates vectors for messages with the current embedding model (no re-analysis). After changing the embedding model, old vectors can't be compared and need rebuilding.
reembed_mode_missing: Only missing or from another model
reembed_no_model: No embedding model yet; set one up above.
retention_confirm_message: Records older than {days} days are deleted right away and can't be recovered.
search_empty_hint: Try other words, or loosen the filters.
search_empty_hint_keyword: Try other keywords or loosen the filters. With an embedding model you can search by meaning.
search_mode_keyword: keywords only (set up an embedding model to search by meaning)
search_placeholder: Search text, image text, summaries, tags…
settings_tab_access_description: Who can sign in, an API token for scripts, and MCP for AI assistants.
settings_tab_accounts_description: Credentials, webhook URLs and pictures of your bots on each platform.
settings_tab_ai_description: Analyze messages and images, categorize them, pull out key facts, and search by meaning.
settings_tab_data_description: How long records are kept and the space they take. Expired records are cleaned up every 10 minutes.
tags_field_new: Press Enter to create a new tag
tags_field_placeholder: Type and press Enter, or pick a suggestion
tasks_empty_hint: Downloads show up here when a message with images or files arrives.
token_copy_now: Copy it now; it won't be shown again.
token_description: Scripts can use it instead of signing in, e.g. to back up messages and files. Header: Authorization: Bearer <token>.
token_reset_message: The old token stops working right away; update scripts that use it.
token_shown_once: Shown only this once; keep it somewhere safe.
trash_description: Deleted messages wait here with their files and can be restored. After the time set in Settings → Data & export, they're deleted for good.
trash_empty_hint: Deleted messages land here first and can be restored.
